opening.argument: The walkthrough shows the mechanics of staking OHM: it explains how to connect a wallet, use the Stake control and reach the Unstake view. The displayed APY is very high, but the accompanying description warns that a very high APY can mean substantial risk and advises viewers to conduct their own research. Taken together, the instructions and risk warning present an educational demonstration, not a claim that viewers will earn the displayed return or that any unstaking transaction was completed.

citations.quote: First, connect your Metamask or WEP3 reward wallet. Check if the network is correct, then click on Connect Wallet.
Just click on the Stake button and wait a few seconds after the transaction has been approved from the wallet.
암호화폐 투자는 고위험을 동반합니다. 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다.
